text: Father Brown seemed to be studying the paper more than the corpse; he held it close to his eyes; and seemed trying to read it in the twilight. Then he held it up against the faint light, and, as he did so, lightning stared at them for an instant so white that the paper looked black against it. Darkness full of thunder followed, and after the thunder Father Brown’s voice said out of the dark: “Doctor, this paper is the wrong shape.” “What do you mean?” asked Doctor Harris, with a frowning stare. “It isn’t square,” answered Brown. “It has a sort of edge snipped off at the corner.
